messages.text: Morning all. SanctionsScreen threw another batch of false positives overnight. 11 hits in the KYC queue, 9 of them look like name-only matches with no DOB or address overlap.
Saw those. Same pattern as last week, the fuzzy match threshold seems to be catching common surnames against the SDN list. I'll start clearing the obvious ones.
Thanks. One I want a second set of eyes on: {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0036}} popped on a partial name match during the periodic refresh. Existing lending client, risk low, since 2020.
Did you compare the DOB? Pull {{CLIENT_DOB:c_0036}} from the file in DocVault and check against the listed entry's DOB and place of birth.
Done. DOB doesn't match the listed entry, and the address {{CLIENT_ADDRESS:c_0036}} is nowhere near any listed location. Score was 82 on name alone. I'm calling it a false positive.
Heather, Anthony: how many false positives are we seeing per day now versus a month ago? If the rate is climbing I want numbers before I take it to Ravi's team.
Rough count from my dispositions: about 6 a day in July, 10-12 a day this week. Haven't pulled a clean report yet, will do that this morning.
Agree with Anthony. I think the threshold change from the vendor list update on the 17th is the trigger. Alert volume jumped right after.
That's plausible. Please put the before/after counts in a ticket. Since KYCPipeline still sits with Ops until October, Ravi has to approve any tuning change, but I want our recommendation documented.
Closing the {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0036}} alert as false positive. Attached DOB and address comparison to the case. Anthony, can you do the QC review?
QC'd, looks good. I noted the DOB mismatch and the second identifier check. Approved, and the lending RM doesn't need to be looped in since there's no hold on a45 the account.
Small catch: the alert did briefly put a hold flag on the loan account {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00078}} in KYCPipeline. Can you confirm it's released? I don't want it blocking a payment.
Checked, the flag cleared when I approved. Checking account {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00077}} was never restricted. All good.
Report is in: 47 alerts since the 17th, 41 closed as false positives, so about 87%. Before that it was closer to 60%. Attaching it to the tuning ticket now.
That's the evidence I needed. I'll raise it with Ravi today and ask for a threshold review with the vendor. Keep clearing alerts manually with the two-identifier check in the meantime. No shortcuts.
Will do. I'll also log any true-hit candidates separately so we can show the tuning doesn't suppress real matches.
